mediaWork.title: Strengthening Forensic Science in the United States: A Path Forward
mediaWork.creatorName: Committee on Identifying the Needs of the Forensic Science Community, National Research Council
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Comprehensive assessment of the state of forensic science in the United States and recommendations for improvement to reduce wrongful convictions
mediaWork.summaryNotes: This report represents a landmark assessment of forensic science in the United States. It takes a comprehensive, systemic approach to examining the entire field of forensic science and its role in the justice system.  The report acknowledges that flawed forensic science has contributed to wrongful convictions and argues that improving forensic science practices is essential for reducing such miscarriages of justice.  The report's recommendations aim to create a more reliable, scientifically sound forensic science system.
